QNT-EUR.summary: QNT is trading amid a fresh, partnership-driven narrative whose token linkage and timing are not specified, while Binance removed the QNT/USDC spot pair on September 18. These are current contextual risks for a QNT entry.
materialRisks: The September 24 Quant/The Clearing House announcement names Quant technology, but does not specify any role for QNT; the participating-institution network is only expected in H1 2027. This creates material news-to-token linkage/timing uncertainty. ([theclearinghouse.org](https://www.theclearinghouse.org/payment-systems/Articles/2026/09/The-Clearing-House-Partners-with-Quant-to-Advance-the--On-Chain-Money-Initiative?utm_source=openai))

Binance ceased QNT/USDC spot trading and related bot services at 03:00 UTC on September 18, 2026. Binance said the action was pair-specific and QNT could remain available through other pairs, but it removes one QNT liquidity route. ([binance.com](https://www.binance.com/pt-AO/support/announcement/detail/30b1347d97324180bb469c761e4eed5a?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: The Clearing House independently confirmed on September 24 that it selected Quant to provide interoperability, orchestration, and transaction-management technology for its On-Chain Money Initiative. ([theclearinghouse.org](https://www.theclearinghouse.org/payment-systems/Articles/2026/09/The-Clearing-House-Partners-with-Quant-to-Advance-the--On-Chain-Money-Initiative?utm_source=openai))

The announcement says the network is expected to be available to participating institutions in the first half of 2027; further participation and use-case details remain pending. ([theclearinghouse.org](https://www.theclearinghouse.org/payment-systems/Articles/2026/09/The-Clearing-House-Partners-with-Quant-to-Advance-the--On-Chain-Money-Initiative?utm_source=openai))

Binance’s September 16 notice removed only QNT/USDC, not QNT itself, effective September 18 at 03:00 UTC. ([binance.com](https://www.binance.com/pt-AO/support/announcement/detail/30b1347d97324180bb469c761e4eed5a?utm_source=openai))
